It stays below about 0.75 (mostly the 0.47 floor on '.') on plain English narration of people or animals handling everyday objects and moving between places (walked to the shop to buy bread, kicked the ball over the fence, put her book on the table), with no numeral or number word, no 'same'/'that'/'it'/'so', no time word (day, night, today, weekday) and no report or science noun.
